probe_source_location: Private qualification sources retained under /tmp/smolbox-qualification on both hosts; exploratory evidence, not a maintained CI runner.
initial_probe_error: The first boot script passed operation_timeout_ms to Client.new instead of Worker.new; validation rejected it before worker I/O. Corrected before creating a machine.
limitations: Only the stated finite workloads were exercised; no production profile is certified.
The guest saw one vCPU. A four-second CPU loop does not certify CPU-time throttling; parent cpu.stat reported no throttling.
Thirty-two guest children ran while the host unit peaked at 26 tasks. Host pids.max is not a guest process-count quota; no pids.max exhaustion was observed.
Memory accounting covers the parent unit and tmpfs, with no recorded cgroup OOM. It is not a universal VMM RSS claim.

The output producer was bounded above at 64 MiB; actual emitted bytes and command outcome after observation loss were not recovered. One stream invocation is test instrumentation, not a durable upstream receipt.

The second trial stops/deletes the owned VM and verifies empty inventory. The disk-full trial instead requires owned unit/mount teardown after failed API deletion; do not count teardown as a successful delete response.
Fresh data roots and per-machine extraction do not mean a pristine/cold host or default Linux shared-cache benchmark. Both starts included the observed ten-second scope-adoption timeout.

The distribution and trusted prepared artifact were outside the private writable data mount. Upstream flags disable per-VM UID dropping/shared extraction in this user namespace. This cannot be advertised as the default deployment security configuration.
Equivalent independently bounded macOS hostile-resource tests, broader endpoint/credential isolation, upstream protocol abuse and protected disposable CI jobs remain pending.
